ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.cus: Customize the look and feel of Local Operator
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.add: Adds the agent's Reasoning and Thinking rows to conversations. They stay closed until you open one. Reasoning only: narration the agent writes as prose mid-turn is transcript content, not reasoning — never removed by either display mode (by turn folds it behind the turn's bars, by response keeps it on screen).
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa: By turn condenses each turn to its answer. By response keeps every settled response on screen, with the turn's final answer still marked.

ui.settings.appearance.contrast.title: Contrast
ui.settings.appearance.contrast.soft_des: Stone and slate grounds with gentler text. Easier on the eyes for long reading.
ui.settings.appearance.contrast.gentle_d: A little lighter and quieter than the theme as designed.
ui.settings.appearance.contrast.high_des: Near-black and near-white for maximum legibility.
ui.settings.appearance.contrast.applies_: Applies to dark themes. Light themes keep their own setting.
Applies to light themes. Dark themes keep their own setting.
ui.settings.appearance.contrast.capped: This theme can only go to {value} while keeping text readable, so that's what is shown.
ui.settings.appearance.accent.title: Accent
ui.settings.appearance.accent.limit: Up to 12 of your accents are kept. Adding another replaces the oldest.
ui.settings.appearance.accent.adjusted: Adjusted for legibility on this theme
ui.settings.appearance.accent.not_applie: This accent can't be made readable on this theme, so the theme's own accent is shown.
ui.settings.appearance.picker.eyedropper: Pick a colour from the screen
ui.settings.appearance.picker.name: Name
ui.settings.appearance.contrast.backgrou: This theme’s background is already as bright as it can go, so higher contrast darkens the text instead.
ui.settings.appearance.contrast.capped_h: This theme has reached its contrast limit while keeping text readable, so the closest readable setting is shown.
